description: This file provides formatting and utility functions for handling sandbox container status output, including string representations of statuses and counters for container items based on their properties.

methods.name: export function formatStatus(running: boolean): string { formatStatus
methods.description: Returns a colored emoji string representing whether a sandbox container is running or stopped.

methods.name: export function formatSimpleStatus(running: boolean): string { formatSimpleStatus
methods.description: Returns a simple string indicating the running state of a container.

methods.name: export function formatImageMatch(matches: boolean): string { formatImageMatch
methods.description: Returns a string symbol indicating whether the container's image matches expected.

methods.name: export function countRunning<T extends { running: boolean }>(items: T[]): number { countRunning
methods.description: Counts the number of items in an array that are marked as running.

methods.name: export function countMismatches<T extends { imageMatch: boolean }>(items: T[]): number { countMismatches
methods.description: Counts the number of items in an array where imageMatch is false.

ctags.pattern: /^export function countMismatches<T extends { imageMatch: boolean }>(items: T[]): number {$/

ctags.pattern: /^export function countRunning<T extends { running: boolean }>(items: T[]): number {$/
